full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white architectural photograph shows bright looping lines of light suspended in the middle of an empty industrial hall. The hall stretches from a wet concrete foreground toward a dark back wall, with worn masonry on both sides and a high pitched roof crossed by exposed beams. Narrow roof windows admit pale ambient daylight, revealing the geometry of the rafters without fully illuminating the room. In the upper middle of the scene, continuous white light traces several broad, irregular loops that sweep left and right just below the beams. Their exact source is obscured, so they read as suspended luminous gestures rather than solid equipment. Below, the damp floor catches broken reflections of the loops and pale roof openings, scattering light into irregular white streaks across the lower center. Long side walls recede toward a small central doorway and additional dark openings at the back, creating strong symmetrical perspective. The wall surfaces show stains, rough plaster, and repeated tall window bays; most of their detail remains in mid-gray shadow. Light from the roof falls gently across the space, while the luminous loops provide the brightest local source and leave faint glints on the floor. Crisp lines at the beam and wall edges contrast with the hazy, overexposed glow of the loops and their watery reflection. The absence of people and furniture makes the empty scale especially clear. The overall composition joins severe industrial depth with a floating, calligraphic burst of light at its center.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白建筑摄影描绘几道明亮环绕的光线悬在空旷工业大厅中央。大厅从潮湿混凝土前景伸向深暗后墙，两侧是磨旧的砌体，高高的坡顶由裸露梁架横穿。狭窄的屋顶天窗让浅淡环境日光进入，显出椽架几何形状，却没有完全照亮室内。画面上方中部，连续白光在梁下画出几道宽阔不规则的环线，向左右扫开。光线的确切来源被遮住，因此它们像悬浮的发光笔势，而非坚实设备。下方，潮湿地面接住环线和浅色屋顶开口的破碎倒影，把光散成下方中央不规则的白色拖痕。长侧墙向后方小中央门洞和其他深色开口退去，形成强烈对称透视。墙面有污渍、粗糙灰泥与反复出现的高窗间隔；大部分细节仍留在中灰阴影中。屋顶的光柔和落在空间里，发光环线则提供最明亮的局部光源，并在地面留下微弱闪光。梁架和墙边的清晰线条与环线及其水样倒影中过曝的朦胧光辉形成对比。没有人物和家具，使空旷尺度格外明确。整体构图把严峻工业纵深与中央一阵悬浮的书写式光线结合起来。
style_prompt_en: The image has a monochrome installation-photography finish that places luminous linework inside a dark, textured spatial field. Long straight architectural edges establish deep perspective, while loose flowing light traces cut across that order. Silver-gray ambient illumination leaves wall and ceiling detail visible but subdued; the brightest marks bloom to near white and break into scattered reflections below. Damp or polished surfaces smear the light into irregular streaks rather than perfect copies. Fine grain, worn material texture, and broad shadow keep the space tactile. The composition uses a large quiet enclosure to amplify a small number of intense, central gestures. The overall effect is austere, atmospheric, and quietly surreal.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有黑白装置摄影质感，把发光线迹置于深暗而带肌理的空间色域中。长而直的结构边缘建立深透视，松动流动的光痕则横切这种秩序。银灰环境光让墙面和顶部细节可见却低调；最亮的标记晕至近白，并在下方破裂成零散反光。潮湿或光滑的表面把光抹成不规则拖痕，而非完整复制。细颗粒、磨旧材料肌理和宽阔阴影保留空间触感。构图运用宽大安静的围合空间，放大少量强烈中央笔势。整体效果冷峻、富大气感且静静地超现实。
theme_en: Luminous loops suspended in an empty industrial hall
theme_zh: 空旷工业厅中悬浮的发光环线
name: James Nizam
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
